UnexpectedMonitorActionHandlingViolation
Description
Sent in case ara::diag::Monitor::ReportMonitorAction is called with a parameter "action" value that is not
supported by the used debouncing method.

0x80003ffe
MessageType
Info

where the violation was detected, for example
\\\{filename}:\\\{linenumber}.
